integrity: Novelty is claimed only for the explicit recursive bijection solving the stated problem, not for the prior Bell-number enumeration. The source paper and a September 2025 author talk both pose the bijection as a problem.
scientific_limitations: The proof uses the published one-point decomposition and uniqueness theorem for finite linear L-algebras. The bundled exhaustive replay checks n<=8 only.
title: An explicit Bell-partition bijection for finite linear L-algebras
